questions.question_text: Concept of multiple inheritance can be implemented by
questions.answer: Java does not allow a class to extend more than one class, but a class can implement several interfaces, which achieves multiple inheritance of type/behaviour.

questions.question_text: Package is referred to as
questions.answer: `package` is a reserved word (keyword) in Java used to declare the package of a class.

questions.question_text: getDocumentBase() is used to load images from the ________.
questions.answer: In an applet, `getDocumentBase()` returns the URL of the directory holding the HTML document; `getCodeBase()` returns the directory holding the applet's class file.

questions.question_text: Method overloading is type of ________.
questions.answer: Overloaded methods are resolved by the compiler from the argument list, so overloading is compile-time (static) polymorphism. Overriding is run-time polymorphism.

questions.question_text: Implements keyword is used to implement an ________
questions.answer: A class uses `implements` to provide bodies for the methods of an interface.

questions.question_text: ________ are the keywords that specify the accessibility or the scope of methods, classes, fields, and other members.
questions.answer: Access specifiers (public, protected, default, private) control visibility of classes and members.

questions.question_text: Which of the following constructor is not used for creating the Thread.
questions.answer: `Thread(Runnable)`, `Thread(Runnable, String)` and `Thread(String)` are valid constructors. Java has no pointer-style `*Runnable` parameter, so option C is invalid.

questions.question_text: ________ is the foundation upon which Swing is made.
questions.answer: Swing components (JFrame, JButton...) are built on top of AWT (JComponent extends java.awt.Container).

questions.question_text: Java Application uses ________ to interact with and access the database.
questions.answer: In the JDBC architecture the application talks to the JDBC API layer (java.sql / javax.sql), which in turn uses the JDBC Driver API layer to reach the database.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is not a container class
questions.answer: Panel, Frame and Dialog can hold other components (they are containers). A MenuBar is a component that is attached to a frame, not a general container.

questions.question_text: Write a program in java to print the prime numbers.
Write a program for the multiplication of array in java
Differentiate between AWT and swing
questions.answer:
| Basis | AWT | Swing |
|---|---|---|
| Package | `java.awt` | `javax.swing` |
| Components | Heavyweight (use native OS peers) | Lightweight (drawn entirely by Java) |
| Look and feel | Platform dependent | Pluggable look and feel, platform independent |
| Component set | Limited (Button, Label, TextField...) | Rich (JTable, JTree, JTabbedPane, JComboBox...) |
| Naming | `Button`, `Frame` | `JButton`, `JFrame` (prefixed with J) |
| Architecture | No MVC support | Based on Model-View-Controller |
| Speed / memory | Faster to start but uses more OS resources | Slightly slower, uses less OS resources |
| Relation | Base GUI toolkit | Built on top of AWT (extension) |
